South Korea Economic Growth Accelerates Driven by AI Chip Demand

28 Oct 2026, 12:45 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Tech Desk · Source: www.aljazeera.com

1 min read

Key takeaways

Image: John Power · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9; original source image

  2. The Role of AI Semiconductors

Surpassing Growth Forecasts

South Korea’s economy grew by 1 percent in the third quarter of 2026, significantly outpacing the Bank of Korea's initial forecast of 0.3 percent. This 3.4 percent year-on-year expansion indicates the nation is on track for its strongest economic performance since 2011.

The Role of AI Semiconductors

The growth is primarily fueled by a surge in exports, which rose 2.3 percent quarter-on-quarter. As home to major manufacturers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, South Korea occupies a dominant position in the global memory chip market. High demand for AI-related technology remains the central driver for this industrial output.
